thought.text: The shared-services COPY only landed in the test-deps stage. Let me fix the helper to insert it in every `/app` stage.

reasoning_content:
The failures are because the COPY 03-shared-services happens after WORKDIR /app in Dockerfiles where the first WORKDIR /app appears in the builder stage but there might be an earlier test-deps stage. Actually the issue: in demos-einwendungsmanagement the shared services ARE copied? The error says "Distribution not found at: file:///app/03-shared-services/ki-validierung". My awk inserted COPY after the first WORKDIR /app. For demos-einwendungsmanagement, the first WORKDIR /app is in test-deps stage (line 9), and my COPY was inserted there, not in builder. Then in builder stage the path refs resolve relative to /app in builder which lacks the directory.

I need to insert the COPY in the builder stage specifically. Let me fix by inserting the COPY before each `uv sync` RUN in the builder stage, or before all uv sync runs. Simpler: insert COPY before every `RUN` that contains `uv sync`.

But COPY after WORKDIR /app... The builder stage has WORKDIR /app then RUN uv sync. Let me insert "COPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/" before every `RUN --mount...uv sync` line. Actually multiple stages. Simplest: insert COPY right before each line containing "uv sync --locked --no-install-project" (the first sync), and also before the test-deps first sync. But test-deps may not have shared services copied... they need it too potentially.

Let me just insert `COPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/` before every RUN block that invokes uv sync. Since RUN blocks are multiline with `\`, the line containing "uv sync" is the last. I can insert a COPY line before the RUN line. Actually simpler: put COPY right after each `WORKDIR /app` occurrence. That handles all stages.

Let me rewrite approach: replace every "WORKDIR /app" with "WORKDIR /app\nCOPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/". But then subsequent COPY . /app would overwrite/merge - fine.

Wait but the service context must contain 03-shared-services. Yes I copy it into CTX.

However the original Dockerfile's `COPY . /app` copies everything including 03-shared-services, so after that it's fine. The issue is only the early sync before `COPY . /app`.

For demos-einwendungsmanagement: first stage test-deps does `COPY . /app` then `uv sync --locked --dev` - that works since full context copied. Hmm wait then error at builder stage. Let me look.

Actually error was in builder stage first sync (`uv sync --locked --no-install-project --no-dev`). My awk inserted COPY at test-deps stage only. Builder stage first sync uses bind mounts only (no COPY . /app yet), so 03-shared-services absent. Need COPY there.

So: insert after every WORKDIR /app. Let me update the helper.

Actually better: insert `COPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/` before the builder's first uv sync. Generic: insert after every "WORKDIR /app".

But careful - if there's already COPY . /app later, that's fine.

For rechtsquellenvorbereitung, error "Distribution not found at: file:///tmp/tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction" - it depends on another backend service (tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction) via absolute path /tmp? Let me check. Actually path = "/tmp/tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction"? Let me look.

Let me fix the helper and rebuild the failures.

action.command:
cat > /tmp/build_generic.sh <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
SVC="$1"; TAG="$2"
SRC=/workspace/02-backend/$SVC
CTX=/tmp/g_$SVC
rm -rf "$CTX"; mkdir -p "$CTX"
cp -r "$SRC"/. "$CTX"/ 2>/dev/null
rm -rf "$CTX/.git"
if grep -q '03-shared-services' "$CTX/pyproject.toml" 2>/dev/null; then
  cp -r /workspace/03-shared-services "$CTX/03-shared-services"
  sed -i 's|path = "\.\./\.\./03-shared-services/|path = "03-shared-services/|g' "$CTX/pyproject.toml"
  # insert COPY after every WORKDIR /app
  awk '{print} /^WORKDIR \/app[[:space:]]*$/ {print "COPY 03-shared-services/ ./03-shared-services/"}' "$CTX/Dockerfile" > "$CTX/Dockerfile.n" && mv "$CTX/Dockerfile.n" "$CTX/Dockerfile"
fi
cd "$CTX"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
rm -f uv.lock
if grep -q 'uv sync' "$CTX/Dockerfile"; then
  uv lock >/tmp/lock_$SVC.log 2>&1 || { echo "LOCKFAIL"; tail -5 /tmp/lock_$SVC.log; exit 3; }
fi
export DUMMY_USER=x DUMMY_TOKEN=x
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build \
  --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_USERNAME,env=DUMMY_USER \
  --secret id=TECHNICAL_USER_TOKEN,env=DUMMY_TOKEN \
  -t "$TAG" .
SH
chmod +x /tmp/build_generic.sh
grep -n 'tatbestands\|/tmp/' /workspace/02-backend/rechtsquellenvorbereitung/pyproject.toml
